plate_comment: Pilot injection timing: calls cm848_calculatePilotInjectionTimingOffset (unless the override DAT_00409e6e is set), adds the offset to main_injection_timing (unless DAT_00409e72 is set), uses injection_timing_pilot_offset_governor_limit_floor while the governor speed limit holds the main timing at its limit, then caps the result at the earliest schedulable angle for the engine speed. The result pilot_injection_timing is the TPU-A channel 5 slot 4 angle. RAM dump: 87 + 162 = 249. (was cm848_pressure_control_state_load)
evidence: verified 2026-11-16 from the decompiled body; G1a traced the consumer chain
the pilot timing offset used in place of the computed one while governor_speed_limit_active_flag is set and the main timing sits at its governor limit (cm848_calculatePilotInjectionTiming)
which term set the pilot timing: 0 computed offset, 7 the override DAT_00409e6e, 8 the governor-limit floor (cm848_calculatePilotInjectionTiming)
